records.title: Do not burn the fat of a blemished sacrifice
records.summary: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the Lord.

records.title: Do not offer an animal with a temporary blemish
records.summary: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the Lord thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the Lord thy God.

records.title: The offering of blemished animals from Gentiles
records.summary: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

records.title: The offering of imperfect animals in sacrifice
records.summary: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

records.title: Do not offer leaven or honey on the altar
records.summary: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.

records.title: Do not offer an unsalted sacrifice
records.summary: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

records.title: Do not bring a prostitute’s hire or the price of a dog as an offering
records.summary: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the Lord thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the Lord thy God.

records.title: To kill an animal and its young on the same day
records.summary: And whether it be cow, or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

records.title: Do not put oil on the sinner’s meal offering
records.summary: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

records.title: Do not put frankincense on the sinner’s meal offering
records.summary: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

records.title: Do not put oil on the jealousy offering
records.summary: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

records.title: Do not put frankincense on the jealousy offering
records.summary: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

records.title: Do not exchange a consecrated animal
records.summary: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

records.title: Do not transfer an animal’s consecration to another kind of offering
records.summary: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord's.

records.title: The redemption of the first-born of clean cattle
records.summary: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

records.title: The sale of the tithe of the herd
records.summary: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

records.title: Do not sell a devoted field
records.summary: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.

records.title: Do not redeem a devoted field
records.summary: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.

records.title: The division of the head of the bird in a sin-offering
records.summary: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

records.title: Do not work a firstborn consecrated animal
records.summary: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the Lord thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

records.title: Do not shear a firstborn consecrated animal
records.summary: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the Lord thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

records.title: Do not slaughter the Passover lamb while leaven remains
records.summary: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

records.title: Do not leave the Passover sacrifice’s fat until morning
records.summary: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

records.title: Do not leave the Passover lamb’s flesh until morning
records.summary: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

records.title: To leave any of the festal offering until the third day
records.summary: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

records.title: To leave part of the second Passover lamb until the morning
records.summary: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

records.title: The preservation of any part of the thank-offering until the morning
records.summary: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the Lord.

records.title: Do not break a bone of the first Passover lamb
records.summary: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

records.title: Do not break a bone of the second Passover lamb
records.summary: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

records.title: To carry of the flesh of Passover out of the house
records.summary: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

records.title: To allow the remnants of the meat-offering to become leavened
records.summary: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

records.title: Do not eat the Passover lamb raw or boiled
records.summary: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

records.title: Do not give the Passover lamb to a resident foreigner or hired worker
records.summary: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

records.title: An uncircumcised person must not eat the Passover lamb
records.summary: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

records.title: An apostate must not eat the Passover lamb
records.summary: And the Lord said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

records.title: An unclean person must not eat consecrated food
records.summary: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

records.title: Do not eat consecrated food that has become unclean
records.summary: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

records.title: Do not eat sacrificial flesh after its prescribed time
records.summary: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

records.title: Do not eat an offering with disqualifying intent
records.summary: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

records.title: A non-priest must not eat the priestly heave offering
records.summary: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

records.title: A priest’s sojourner or hired worker must not eat the heave offering
records.summary: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

records.title: An uncircumcised priest must not eat the heave offering
records.summary: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

records.title: An unclean priest must not eat the heave offering
records.summary: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

records.title: A priest's daughter married to a stranger may not eat of the holy things
records.summary: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

records.title: Do not eat a priest’s meal offering
records.summary: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

records.title: Do not eat a sin offering whose blood was brought inside
records.summary: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

records.title: Do not eat disqualified consecrated food
records.summary: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

records.title: Do not eat second-tithe grain outside Jerusalem
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not drink second-tithe wine outside Jerusalem
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not eat second-tithe oil outside Jerusalem
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not eat the unblemished firstborn offering outside Jerusalem
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not eat sin or guilt offerings outside the court
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not eat the flesh of a burnt offering
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not eat lesser holy offerings before the blood is sprinkled
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: A stranger may not eat of the flesh of the most holy things
records.summary: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

records.title: The priest may not eat of the first-fruits before they are brought into the court
records.summary: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

records.title: Do not eat the second tithe in mourning
records.summary: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the Lord my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

records.title: Do not eat the second tithe while unclean
records.summary: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the Lord my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

records.title: Use of the money of the second tithe except for eating or drinking
records.summary: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the Lord my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

records.title: Eating the corn before the heave-offerings and tithes have been separated
records.summary: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord;

records.title: Changing the order regarding the wave-offering, the first-fruits, and the first and second tithes
records.summary: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

records.title: The delay of vows and free-will offerings
records.summary: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the Lord thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the Lord thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.

records.title: Attendance at the feast without an offering
records.summary: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

records.title: The violation of vows
records.summary: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

records.title: A priest must not marry a woman prohibited as a harlot
records.summary: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

records.title: A priest must not marry a woman prohibited as profaned
records.summary: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

records.title: A priest must not marry a divorced woman
records.summary: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

records.title: The high priest must not marry a widow
records.summary: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

records.title: The high priest must not have relations with a widow outside marriage
records.summary: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

records.title: A priest must not enter service with unkempt hair
records.summary: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.

records.title: A priest must not enter service with torn garments
records.summary: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.

records.title: Priests may not leave the court during service
records.summary: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

records.title: An ordinary priest must not become unclean through a prohibited corpse
records.summary: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

records.title: The high priest must not enter where a corpse is present
records.summary: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

records.title: The high priest must not become unclean through a corpse
records.summary: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

records.title: Levites must not receive a territorial inheritance
records.summary: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance.

records.title: Levites must not take a share of war spoils
records.summary: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance.

records.title: To make oneself bald for the dead
records.summary: Ye are the children of the Lord your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

records.title: Do not eat unclean land animals
records.summary: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

records.title: Do not eat unclean fish
records.summary: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

records.title: Do not eat unclean birds
records.summary: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

records.title: Do not eat flying swarming creatures
records.summary: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

records.title: Do not eat creatures that swarm on the earth
records.summary: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

records.title: Do not eat creatures that breed in decaying matter
records.summary: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

records.title: Do not eat creatures that breed in seeds or fruit
records.summary: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

records.title: Do not eat any prohibited swarming creature
records.summary: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

records.title: Do not eat an animal that died without prescribed slaughter
records.summary: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

records.title: Do not eat flesh torn by wild beasts
records.summary: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

records.title: Do not eat a limb taken from a living animal
records.summary: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

records.title: Do not eat the sinew of the thigh
records.summary: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

records.title: Do not eat blood
records.summary: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

records.title: Do not eat prohibited fat
records.summary: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

records.title: Do not cook meat with milk
records.summary: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

records.title: Do not eat meat cooked with milk
records.summary: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

records.title: The eating of the flesh of an ox that has been stoned
records.summary: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

records.title: Do not eat new-grain bread before the offering
records.summary: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

records.title: Do not eat roasted new grain before the offering
records.summary: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

records.title: Do not eat fresh new-grain ears before the offering
records.summary: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

records.title: The use of the fruit of a young tree before the fourth year
records.summary: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

records.title: The eating of mixed seeds of the vineyard
records.summary: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, be defiled.

records.title: The use of libations to idols
records.summary: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

records.title: Gluttony and drunkenness
records.summary: And they shall say unto the elders of his city, This our son is stubborn and rebellious, he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton, and a drunkard.

records.title: Eating on the Day of Atonement
records.summary: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

records.title: Do not eat leaven during Passover
records.summary: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

records.title: Do not eat a mixture containing leaven during Passover
records.summary: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

records.title: Do not eat leaven after midday before Passover
records.summary: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

records.title: Do not allow leaven to be seen during Passover
records.summary: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

records.title: Do not possess leaven during Passover
records.summary: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

records.title: A Nazirite must not drink wine
records.summary: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

records.title: A Nazirite must not eat fresh grapes
records.summary: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

records.title: A Nazirite must not eat dried grapes
records.summary: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

records.title: A Nazirite must not eat grape seeds
records.summary: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

records.title: A Nazirite must not eat grape skins
records.summary: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

records.title: A Nazirite must not become unclean through the dead
records.summary: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

records.title: A Nazirite must not enter a place containing a corpse
records.summary: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.

records.title: A Nazirite must not shave during the vow
records.summary: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

records.title: Do not reap the corners of the field
records.summary: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

records.title: Do not gather the harvest gleanings
records.summary: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

records.title: Do not gather the small grape clusters
records.summary: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.

records.title: Do not gather the fallen grapes
records.summary: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.

records.title: Do not return for a forgotten sheaf
records.summary: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.

records.title: Do not sow mixed seed in a field
records.summary: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

records.title: Do not sow mixed seed in a vineyard
records.summary: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, be defiled.

records.title: The gendering of cattle with those of diverse species
records.summary: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

records.title: The use of two different kinds of cattle together
records.summary: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.

records.title: The prevention of an animal working in the field from eating
records.summary: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.

records.title: Do not cultivate the land in the seventh year
records.summary: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

records.title: Do not prune trees in the seventh year
records.summary: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

records.title: Do not reap seventh-year growth as an ordinary harvest
records.summary: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

records.title: Do not gather seventh-year fruit as an ordinary harvest
records.summary: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

records.title: Do not cultivate the land in the jubilee year
records.summary: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

records.title: Do not reap jubilee-year growth as an ordinary harvest
records.summary: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

records.title: Do not gather jubilee-year fruit as an ordinary harvest
records.summary: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

records.title: The permanent sale of a field in the land of Israel
records.summary: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine, for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

records.title: To change the suburbs of the Levites or their fields
records.summary: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

records.title: To leave the Levite without support
records.summary: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

records.title: To demand the amount of a debt after the lapse of the seventh year
records.summary: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the Lord's release.

records.title: To refuse to lend to the poor on account of the release year
records.summary: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the Lord against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

records.title: To refuse to lend to the poor the things which he requires
records.summary: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

records.title: Sending a Hebrew slave away empty-handed
records.summary: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

records.title: Exaction with regard to loans to the poor
records.summary: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

records.title: Do not lend to an Israelite at interest
records.summary: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

lens.description: Jesus connects lending with love and generosity, expecting nothing in return.

records.title: Do not borrow at interest
records.summary: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

records.title: Usury, or participation therein either as surety, witness, or writer of contracts
records.summary: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

records.title: Delay in the payment of wages
records.summary: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

records.title: Do not seize a debtor’s pledge by force
records.summary: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge.

records.title: Do not retain a needed pledge from the poor
records.summary: And if the man be poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:

records.title: Do not take a widow’s garment as a pledge
records.summary: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, nor of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment to pledge:

records.title: Do not take implements of livelihood as a pledge
records.summary: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge: for he taketh a man's life to pledge.

records.title: To kidnap a man of Israel
records.summary: Thou shalt not steal.

records.title: To steal
records.summary: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

records.title: To rob by violence
records.summary: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

records.title: To remove the landmark
records.summary: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess it.

records.title: Do not withhold a neighbor’s property
records.summary: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

records.title: Do not deny a debt or deposit
records.summary: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

records.title: Do not swear falsely concerning another’s property
records.summary: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

records.title: To injure any one in bargaining
records.summary: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

records.title: Do not wrong a person in speech
records.summary: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the Lord your God.

records.title: Do not wrong a stranger in speech
records.summary: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

records.title: Do not wrong a stranger in commerce
records.summary: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

records.title: Do not return a fugitive slave to the master
records.summary: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:

records.title: Do not oppress a fugitive slave
records.summary: He shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.

records.title: To afflict the widow and orphan
records.summary: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

records.title: Do not assign degrading slave labor to a Hebrew servant
records.summary: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

records.title: Do not sell a Hebrew servant as a bondman
records.summary: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

records.title: Do not make a Hebrew servant work with severity
records.summary: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

records.title: To permit a heathen to treat a Hebrew servant cruelly
records.summary: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

records.title: To sell a Hebrew maid servant
records.summary: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

records.title: To withhold from a betrothed Hebrew slave food, raiment, or conjugal rights
records.summary: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

records.title: To sell as a slave a beautiful captive
records.summary: And it shall be, if thou have no delight in her, then thou shalt let her go whither she will; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money, thou shalt not make merchandise of her, because thou hast humbled her.

records.title: To humble a beautiful woman
records.summary: And it shall be, if thou have no delight in her, then thou shalt let her go whither she will; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money, thou shalt not make merchandise of her, because thou hast humbled her.

records.title: To covet a man's wife
records.summary: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.

records.title: Covetousness
records.summary: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.

records.title: A worker must not put the employer’s produce in a vessel
records.summary: When thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.

records.title: A worker must not cut the employer’s standing grain for personal use
records.summary: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing corn.

records.title: To hide when a thing lost is to be returned to the owner
records.summary: In like manner shalt thou do with his ass; and so shalt thou do with his raiment; and with all lost thing of thy brother's, which he hath lost, and thou hast found, shalt thou do likewise: thou mayest not hide thyself.

records.title: To refrain from helping an animal fallen under its burden
records.summary: Thou shalt not see thy brother's ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again.

records.title: Do not use false weights or measures
records.summary: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

records.title: Do not keep false weights or measures
records.summary: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.

records.title: Do not act unjustly in judgment
records.summary: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

records.title: The acceptance of bribes
records.summary: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

records.title: A judge must not favor a litigant
records.summary: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

records.title: A judge must not fear a litigant
records.summary: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

records.title: To pity the poor in judgment
records.summary: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

records.title: To pervert the judgment of a sinner
records.summary: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

records.title: To spare the offender in matters of fines
records.summary: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.

records.title: To pervert the judgment of strangers or orphans
records.summary: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, nor of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment to pledge:

records.title: To hear one litigant except in the presence of the other
records.summary: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

records.title: To decide by a majority of one in capital cases
records.summary: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

records.title: Having first pleaded for a man in a capital case, one may not afterward plead against him
records.summary: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

records.title: The appointment as judge of one who is not learned in the Law
records.summary: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

records.title: False witness
records.summary: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

records.title: The acceptance of testimony from a wicked person
records.summary: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

records.title: The testimony of relatives
records.summary: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

records.title: To pronounce judgment upon the testimony of only one witness
records.summary: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.

records.title: Do not kill the innocent
records.summary: Thou shalt not kill.

records.title: To convict on circumstantial evidence only
records.summary: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

records.title: To condemn to death on the evidence of only one witness
records.summary: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

records.title: To execute before conviction one charged with a crime
records.summary: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

records.title: To pity or spare the persecutor
records.summary: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.

records.title: To punish the victim in a case of rape
records.summary: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death: for as when a man riseth against his neighbour, and slayeth him, even so is this matter:

records.title: Do not accept ransom for a murderer
records.summary: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

records.title: Do not accept ransom to exempt a manslayer from exile
records.summary: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

records.title: The toleration of bloodshed
records.summary: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour; I am the Lord.

records.title: Do not leave a dangerous obstacle
records.summary: When thou buildest a new house, then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof, that thou bring not blood upon thine house, if any man fall from thence.

records.title: Do not mislead the unwary
records.summary: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.

records.title: To exceed the number of stripes assigned to the guilty
records.summary: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.

records.title: Calumny
records.summary: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour; I am the Lord.

records.title: To bear hatred in one's heart
records.summary: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

records.title: To cause the face of an Israelite to blush
records.summary: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

records.title: Do not take revenge
records.summary: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.

records.title: Do not bear a grudge
records.summary: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.

records.title: To take the dam with the young
records.summary: If a bird's nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree, or on the ground, whether they be young ones, or eggs, and the dam sitting upon the young, or upon the eggs, thou shalt not take the dam with the young:

records.title: Do not shave the affected area of a scall
records.summary: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

records.title: Do not remove the signs of leprosy
records.summary: Take heed in the plague of leprosy, that thou observe diligently, and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you: as I commanded them, so ye shall observe to do.

records.title: To plow or sow in a valley in which a slain body has been found
records.summary: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the valley:

records.title: To suffer a witch to live
records.summary: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

records.title: To force a bridegroom to perform military service
records.summary: When a man hath taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: but he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken.

records.title: Rebellion against the Sanhedrin
records.summary: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.

records.title: Do not add to the commandments
records.summary: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

records.title: Do not subtract from the commandments
records.summary: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

records.title: Do not curse a judge
records.summary: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

records.title: Do not curse a ruler
records.summary: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

records.title: To curse any Israelite
records.summary: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.

records.title: Do not curse a parent
records.summary: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

records.title: Do not strike a parent
records.summary: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

records.title: Do not work on the Sabbath
records.summary: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

records.title: Do not travel beyond the Sabbath boundary
records.summary: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

records.title: To punish on the Sabbath
records.summary: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

records.title: Do not work on the first day of Passover
records.summary: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

records.title: Do not work on the seventh day of Passover
records.summary: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

records.title: Do not work on Shavuot
records.summary: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

records.title: Do not work on the first day of Tishri
records.summary: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

records.title: Do not work on the Day of Atonement
records.summary: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the Lord your God.

records.title: Do not work on the first day of Sukkot
records.summary: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

records.title: Do not work on the eighth day of Sukkot
records.summary: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s mother
records.summary: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s father’s wife
records.summary: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s sister
records.summary: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s father’s wife’s daughter
records.summary: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s son’s daughter
records.summary: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s daughter’s daughter
records.summary: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s daughter
records.summary: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with a woman and her daughter
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with a woman and her son’s daughter
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with a woman and her daughter’s daughter
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s father’s sister
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s mother’s sister
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s father’s brother’s wife
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s son’s wife
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s brother’s wife
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

records.title: Do not have relations with one’s wife’s sister
records.summary: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.

records.title: To have intercourse with a menstruous woman
records.summary: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

records.title: Do not commit adultery
records.summary: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

records.title: A man must not have relations with an animal
records.summary: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

records.title: A woman must not have relations with an animal
records.summary: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

records.title: Do not have sexual relations between males
records.summary: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

records.title: Do not have sexual relations with one’s father
records.summary: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

records.title: Do not have sexual relations with one’s father’s brother
records.summary: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

records.title: Do not engage in prohibited sexual intimacy
records.summary: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.

records.title: Marriage restrictions concerning a person of prohibited parentage
records.summary: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the Lord.

records.title: Harlotry
records.summary: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

records.title: The remarriage of a divorcee with her first husband
records.summary: Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that is abomination before the Lord: and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.

records.title: The marriage of a widow with any one but the brother of her deceased husband
records.summary: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother unto her.

records.title: Divorcing of a victim of rape by the offender
records.summary: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel's father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife; because he hath humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.

records.title: Divorcing of a wife upon whom an evil name has been brought
records.summary: And they shall amerce him in an hundred shekels of silver, and give them unto the father of the damsel, because he hath brought up an evil name upon a virgin of Israel: and she shall be his wife; he may not put her away all his days.

records.title: The marriage of a eunuch with a daughter of Israel
records.summary: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord.

records.title: The castration of any male whatsoever
records.summary: Ye shall not offer unto the Lord that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

records.title: The election of a stranger as king over Israel
records.summary: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.

records.title: A king must not multiply horses
records.summary: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the Lord hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

records.title: A king must not multiply wives
records.summary: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

records.title: A king must not amass excessive silver and gold
records.summary: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
